java_trace.long_comment: tim.iterator.CodeIteratorLongComment#peek with text.TLineType#getFromLineInternal: COMMENT_LONG_START = ^\s*/' and the line contains no '/; lines are skipped until one whose trimmed text endsWith '/.
java_trace.short_comment: tim.iterator.CodeIteratorShortComment#peek: TLineType COMMENT_SIMPLE = ^\s*' (SIMPLE1) or ^\s*/'.*'/\s*$ (SIMPLE2); the whole line is dropped.
java_trace.inner_comment: tim.iterator.CodeIteratorInnerComment#peek returns source.peek().removeInnerComment() for every surviving line. text.StringLocated#removeInnerComment: trim = s.replace('\t',' ').trim() (Java String#trim: strips chars <= U+0020). (1) leading: trim.startsWith("/'") and idx = s.indexOf("'/") != -1 -> removeSpecialInnerComment(s.substring(idx + 2)). (2) trailing: trim.endsWith("'/") and idx = s.lastIndexOf("/'") != -1 -> removeSpecialInnerComment(s.substring(0, idx)). (3) triple: trim contains "/'''" and "'''/" -> removeSpecialInnerComment(s). Otherwise unchanged. removeSpecialInnerComment: if s contains both "/'''" and "'''/", s.replaceAll("/'''[-\\w]*'''/", "") (Java \w without UNICODE_CHARACTER_CLASS = [A-Za-z0-9_]); otherwise unchanged.
java_trace.quotes: removeInnerComment has no quote handling: a /' ... '/ span is removed whether or not it sits inside double quotes, and an apostrophe that is not part of /' or '/ is never touched. Java has no trailing-apostrophe comment form at all.
java_trace.not_in_scope: preproc2.ReadFilterQuoteComment (used only by ReadFilterMergeLines for backslash-continued lines and by ReadFilterAddConfig) also calls removeInnerComment; it belongs to the line-continuation reader, not this stage.

rust_locations: crates/rustuml-parser/src/preprocess/mod.rs::remove_inner_comment (new): literal port of StringLocated#removeInnerComment and #removeSpecialInnerComment, Java String#trim semantics

crates/rustuml-parser/src/preprocess/mod.rs::PreprocessContext::process_one_line: after the existing long-comment and whole-line ' handling, the line is replaced by remove_inner_comment(line) before every later stage (sprite role/exemption, strip_inline_comment, @start/@end, definelong/sub collection, function definition, while/foreach, directives, output). A line that starts with /' and contains '/ but does not end with '/ (or /') is no longer dropped as a whole-line comment: Java's TLineType gives it PLAIN, and removeInnerComment keeps the text after the first '/.
invariant: Every line that survives Java's long/short comment stages reaches the rest of TIM, and through it the diagram commands, with exactly the text StringLocated#removeInnerComment returns; the sprite exemption and Rust's other comment handling then act on that text.
causal_divergence: Rust has no removeInnerComment. On ordinary lines the Rust-only strip_inline_comment cuts at the apostrophe of a trailing '/ (leaving "/' end" in the line); on sprite-owned lines the round-3 exemption skips all comment handling, so CommandFactorySprite / CommandSpriteSvgMultiline see the /' ... '/ text and their start or END grammar fails. A line that starts with /' ... '/ and continues is dropped whole instead of keeping its tail.
planned_change: Add remove_inner_comment and apply it in process_one_line at Java's it40 position. Narrow the whole-line /' check so that only Java's COMMENT_LONG_START (kept with Rust's existing ends_with("/'") extension) and COMMENT_SIMPLE2 (trimmed text ends with '/) drop the line; other /'-prefixed lines go to remove_inner_comment. No other comment behaviour changes: block-comment termination, whole-line ', the EBNF exemption, strip_inline_comment and the sprite exemption are unchanged.
cross_family_scope: The stage runs on every line of every diagram type (all @start kinds, includes, procedure/definelong/sub bodies, theme bodies, the source-identity pass that feeds UmlSource). Any line containing /' or '/ or /''' can change. Pre-implementation scan (Java rule over the repository): 0 goldens, 17 lines in test-diagrams/perturbations (ck3 sprite pairs, tim-evaluated-event-stream, tim-expression-event-sink, tim-theme-post-expansion-source-identity and the retained copies under class-command-*). ck3_svg_inline_quoted_apostrophe_seq: Pre-implementation trace: its two lines contain no /', '/ or /''', so removeInnerComment does not change them. Java's internal-exception page is a java.lang.NullPointerException at klimt.color.HColorSet#parseColor (HColorSet.java:76) from svg.parser.SvgNanoParser#drawText (SvgNanoParser.java:302): the sprite's <text> has no fill, getFillString returns null and getColorOrWhite(null) dereferences it. 93bf53e18 rejected the input only because the Rust-only strip_inline_comment truncated the SVG at " ' s" (sprite never completed).
